title: Bus crashes in north-eastern Brazil, killing 15 people, say police
summary: Driver lost control of bus in Saloá in Pernambuco state and cause of accident is under investigation A passenger bus in north-eastern Brazil has crashed into a sand embankment and flipped on its side, killing 15 people, local authorities have said. The bus was carrying about 30 passengers, police said on Saturday, but the number of injured, who were taken to nearby hospitals, was not immediately clear. The vehicle departed from the state of Bahia and crashed in Saloá, a city in the neighbouring state of Pernambuco. Continue reading...

title: No Kings protests: Saturday marches begin around the country
summary: This summer, organizers said more than 5 million people participated in No Kings protests against President Trump. Organizers say they expect an even bigger turnout this time around.
